title: (console-era remnant, small): the game's text and font path holds characters as 16-bit codes, the console font format's range: CharStrmReader reads UTF-8 of at most three bytes and UTF-16 units (CharStrmReader.cpp:10-33), the tag processors take a u16 code, and the cooked font (NFNT) finds a glyph through two 256-entry pages by the code's high and low byte (native_data.rs:244-257). A character past U+FFFF cannot be drawn; the host's own reader of the same text (host_main.cpp message_utf8) joins surrogate pairs.
note: Found by the inventory's pass two (docs/engine/CONSOLE-FREE.md, 11-18). Nothing shown today is past U+FFFF. Modern form: code points as 32-bit values through the readers and tag processors; NFNT version 2 with a code table by range; a test draws a character past U+FFFF from a test font. 11-18 (the harness's Util report, checked at 241395b49): the text formatter's %c keeps the low 16 bits of its argument (TextString.cpp:108-112). 11-18 (the harness's runtime/src/ui report, checked at 241395b49): the update notice is handed to the game as UTF-16 units, one per call under a lock (launcher_text, launcher.cpp:162-166), a code past U+FFFF split into a surrogate pair (:65-74). 11-18 (the harness's crates/nebula-import report, checked at 241395b49): the cooked message text is u16 units (Nmsg.text, crates/nebula-import/src/cook/message.rs:40-43); a mod font's metrics are cooked into the NFNT's byte fields, ascent, descent, cell and baseline u8 and line feed i8, each glyph's left and widths a byte (font_cook.rs:234-250; the glyph record, native_data.rs:253).

note: Found by the inventory's pass two (the Game/Screen whole read, 11-18, every line cited read at 6577392b5). title: (read past the text): a message tag's claimed length is trusted. The ruby tag copies its base text, up to 255 units by a byte of the tag, from after the tag with no check against the text left (CustomTagProcessor.cpp:644-654, the copy at :653). NebulaUi's wrapWords steps over a tag by its claimed length and reads pSource[end] past the terminator before its clamp (NebulaUi.cpp:154-160). A mod's or an edited message can claim more than it holds.
note: Found by the readall harness's Game/Screen report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49. Fix: bound both by the text's length (P-202's typed tag records remove the cause).

title: (memory, shared helpers): the line copy of MessageUtil copies a tag's bytes without counting them against the room (MessageUtil.cpp:89-113, the tag loop at :94-98); addNumberFontTag assumes 256 units of room and keeps the tag's size in its byte field, cut past 255 (StringUtil.cpp:215-233, :223, :229); convertUTF16ToASCII bounds by num - 1 against an unsigned count, so 0 writes without end (:252-266); emitEffectWithEmitterCallBack uses the emitter unchecked, a name the keeper lacks a null (EffectUtil.cpp:72-73); tryCreateCollisionMoveLimit writes the parts before its null check (LiveActorUtil.cpp:2219-2222); the effect-name cache's heap_realloc is unchecked (MotionSignal.cpp:44-49); pointer touch ids are addresses and sums of two addresses, which can be equal (StarPointerUtil.cpp:127, :254, :294, :502); BezierSurface::setDivideLevel neither checks the level against the table of 7 nor resizes the cache made for the first (BezierSurface.cpp:594-604, :634-636).
note: Found by the readall harness's Game/Util report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49.
